mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the chest and lower body was most worthwhile: the diaphragm and separate routes helped me see how the regions connect.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the repaired skin segment was mostly a predictable slot-filling step, although the scar was a useful reminder of the repair.

surprise.text: The lymph return joined the same neck vein already in the chest model, rather than adding another connection.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary; the named slots and described connections gave the fittings a purpose, though some were straightforward.

continue.text: I would choose to continue if another chapter explored how the connected systems work together. The final cutaway made me curious about those interactions, though the repeated fittings were less engaging.
